scope: Quick Wins — Wire What Exists (8 gaps, LOW complexity)

tasks.title: Add delegate broker persistence
tasks.description: Add saveJobState/loadJobStates methods to DelegateBroker. Persist job records to .writing/delegate/{jobId}.json on every status transition. Recover on construction.

tasks.title: Register LLM providers in DI container
tasks.description: 1) Add ILLMProvider to container/types.ts with registerProvider(name, config) method. 2) Create LLMProviderFactory in container/adapters.ts. 3) In container/bindings.ts, bind default providers (openai, anthropic) from env vars. 4) Pass providers map to LLMServiceImpl constructor.

tasks.title: Wire PhaseOrchestrator quality gates into gateway
tasks.description: Inject IPhaseOrchestrator into MaestroGateway. Call phaseOrchestrator.checkQualityGate(phase, stage) before advancing workflow stages. Block transition on gate failure.
tasks.convergence: Quality gate failure blocks workflow stage transition

tasks.title: Add LLM token budget pre-check
tasks.description: 1) Add tokenBudget and tokensUsed fields to LLMServiceConfig. 2) Add checkBudget() method verifying tokensUsed + estimated < tokenBudget. 3) Call checkBudget before each provider.complete() in generateWithMetadata/generateJson/stream. 4) Throw BudgetExceededError if over. 5) Track cumulative usage per session.
tasks.convergence: LLM dispatch blocked when budget exceeded

tasks.title: Wire WebSocket relay into delegate broker and phase orchestrator
tasks.description: 1) Add IWebSocketRelayService symbol to container/types.ts. 2) Inject into DelegateBroker — call relay.broadcast('delegate:status', payload) on job start/complete/fail. 3) Inject into PhaseOrchestrator — broadcast gate status. 4) Bind in container/bindings.ts.
tasks.convergence: Delegate and phase events broadcast over WebSocket

tasks.title: Wire DistillationNowledgeBridge in DI container
tasks.description: 1) Add IDistillationNowledgeBridge to container/types.ts. 2) Create DistillationNowledgeBridgeAdapter in container/adapters.ts wrapping DistillationNowledgeBridge. 3) Bind in container/bindings.ts with INowledgeMemService + IObsidianService dependencies. 4) Wire into DistillationService.distill() to auto-persist results.

tasks.title: Wire ConflictNowledgeBridge in DI container
tasks.description: 1) Add IConflictNowledgeBridge to container/types.ts. 2) Create ConflictNowledgeBridgeAdapter in container/adapters.ts. 3) Bind in container/bindings.ts with INowledgeMemService dependency. 4) Wire into ObsidianService.sync() to trigger conflict detection on vault changes.
tasks.convergence: Conflict detection triggered on Obsidian sync

tasks.title: Define IFileSyncAdapter and unify three sync paths
tasks.description: 1) Define IFileSyncAdapter interface in container/types.ts with sync(direction, source, target), getSyncHistory(), getIndexedFiles() methods. 2) Create ObsidianSyncAdapter, CloudSyncAdapter, KnowledgeSyncAdapter implementations. 3) Register adapters in container/bindings.ts. 4) FileSyncService delegates to appropriate adapter based on sync type. 5) Register FileSyncService itself in the container.
tasks.convergence: Three sync paths share IFileSyncAdapter interface and are DI-discoverable
